issue_request: Published/Persuasive R5 request to change JournalIssueMedium to CitedMedium, lower-case the existing terms, and add offline-digital-storage, print-without-issue, and offline-digital-storage-without-issue for Citation cited-medium use cases.
initial_application: Commit e7d479cbe3978099d0b9c16201c07a2f3019dd0c explicitly cites J#33090, deletes the old journal-issue-medium source, adds codesystem-cited-medium.xml with the six requested concepts, renames the ValueSet source to valueset-cited-medium.xml, and updates the Citation binding metadata. The checked-in R5 history shows CitedMedium with all six requested concepts and Citation.citedArtifact.publicationForm.citedMedium bound to ValueSet/cited-medium.
additional_context: FHIR-32322 was the broader Citation value set request that identified this change before separate focused trackers handled individual items. FHIR-37913 later moved citedMedium from periodicRelease to publicationForm while retaining the CitedMedium binding. FHIR-39632 and commit caa1fb75adbcca96f92873c7d958e31f547124bb moved duplicated Citation terminology definitions out of base FHIR and updated Citation bindings to terminology.hl7.org. Later commit 71567db3ee2d9fe45368e165a2bd55ff069b4d44 removed Citation from current core, and current source says Citation moved to the Evidence Based Medicine on FHIR IG.
reconciliation: No source files were changed.
